dz: 美国独立战争：英美军队在罗德岛战役中犹豫不决。
de: American Revolutionary War: British and American forces battle indecisively at the Battle of Rhode Island.

t: 《伊斯顿条约》在新泽西州印第安米尔斯为莱纳佩人建立了第一个美国印第安人保留地.
te: The Treaty of Easton establishes the first American Indian reservation, at Indian Mills, New Jersey, for the Lenape.
dz: 《伊斯顿条约》在新泽西州印第安米尔斯为莱纳佩人建立了第一个美国印第安人保留地.
de: The Treaty of Easton establishes the first American Indian reservation, at Indian Mills, New Jersey, for the Lenape.

t: 腓特烈大帝攻击萨克森，欧洲七年战争开始。
te: Frederick the Great attacks Saxony, beginning the Seven Years' War in Europe.
dz: 腓特烈大帝攻击萨克森，欧洲七年战争开始。
de: Frederick the Great attacks Saxony, beginning the Seven Years' War in Europe.

t: 日本沿岸至少有2000人被大岛爆发所引发的海啸淹没.
te: The eruption of Oshima–Ōshima and the Kampo tsunami: At least 2,000 people along the Japanese coast drown in a tsunami …
dz: 大岛和坎波海啸的爆发: 日本沿岸至少有2000人被大岛爆发所引发的海啸淹没.
de: The eruption of Oshima–Ōshima and the Kampo tsunami: At least 2,000 people along the Japanese coast drown in a tsunami caused by the eruption of Oshima.

t: 格陵兰的努克市由皇家总督克赖斯·帕尔斯(Claus Paarss)建立为戈德特-哈布的要塞.
te: The city of Nuuk in Greenland is founded as the fort of Godt-Haab by the royal governor Claus Paarss.
dz: 格陵兰的努克市由皇家总督克赖斯·帕尔斯(Claus Paarss)建立为戈德特-哈布的要塞.
de: The city of Nuuk in Greenland is founded as the fort of Godt-Haab by the royal governor Claus Paarss.

t: Guru Granth Sahib由Guru Arjan完全编译并完成.
te: The Guru Granth Sahib is fully compiled and completed by Guru Arjan.
dz: Guru Granth Sahib由Guru Arjan完全编译并完成.
de: The Guru Granth Sahib is fully compiled and completed by Guru Arjan.

t: 丰臣藏道士在全国颁布"猎剑法令",解除农民武装,使武士和平民阶级牢牢地分出来,防止农民起义,进…
te: Toyotomi Hideyoshi issues a nationwide sword hunting ordinance, disarming the peasantry so as to firmly separate the sa…
dz: 丰臣藏道士在全国颁布"猎剑法令",解除农民武装,使武士和平民阶级牢牢地分出来,防止农民起义,进一步集中了自己的力量.
de: Toyotomi Hideyoshi issues a nationwide sword hunting ordinance, disarming the peasantry so as to firmly separate the samurai and commoner classes, prevent peasant uprisings, and further centralise his own power.

t: 奥斯曼土耳其人夺取了匈牙利王国的首都布达.
te: The Ottoman Turks capture Buda, the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom.
dz: 奥斯曼土耳其人夺取了匈牙利王国的首都布达.
de: The Ottoman Turks capture Buda, the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom.

t: 由苏莱曼所率领的奥斯曼土耳其人被壮族击败并杀死了匈牙利和波希米亚的最后一位贾吉伦国王.
te: The Ottoman Turks led by Suleiman the Magnificent defeat and kill the last Jagiellonian king of Hungary and Bohemia.
dz: 摩哈克之战:由苏莱曼所率领的奥斯曼土耳其人被壮族击败并杀死了匈牙利和波希米亚的最后一位贾吉伦国王.
de: Battle of Mohács: The Ottoman Turks led by Suleiman the Magnificent defeat and kill the last Jagiellonian king of Hungary and Bohemia.

t: 奥斯曼土耳其人攻克了纳恩多夫赫尔瓦尔瓦尔 (贝尔格莱德).
te: The Ottoman Turks capture Nándorfehérvár (Belgrade).
dz: 奥斯曼土耳其人攻克了纳恩多夫赫尔瓦尔瓦尔 (贝尔格莱德).
de: The Ottoman Turks capture Nándorfehérvár (Belgrade).

t: 瓦斯科·达伽马决定离开卡利卡特返回葡萄牙王国。
te: Vasco da Gama decides to depart Calicut and return to the Kingdom of Portugal.
dz: 瓦斯科·达伽马决定离开卡利卡特返回葡萄牙王国。
de: Vasco da Gama decides to depart Calicut and return to the Kingdom of Portugal.

t: 教宗英诺森特八世接任教宗斯诺特斯四世.
te: Pope Innocent VIII succeeds Pope Sixtus IV.
dz: 教宗英诺森特八世接任教宗斯诺特斯四世.
de: Pope Innocent VIII succeeds Pope Sixtus IV.

t: 皮基尼条约正式结束了法国和英国之间的战争。
te: The Treaty of Picquigny formally ends the war between the kingdoms of France and England.
dz: 百年战争：皮基尼条约正式结束了法国和英国之间的战争。
de: Hundred Years' War: The Treaty of Picquigny formally ends the war between the kingdoms of France and England.

t: Timur首次从苏丹艾哈迈德·贾莱伊手中夺取巴格达.
te: Timur takes Baghdad from Sultan Ahmad Jalayir for the first time.
dz: Timur首次从苏丹艾哈迈德·贾莱伊手中夺取巴格达.
de: Timur takes Baghdad from Sultan Ahmad Jalayir for the first time.

t: 温切尔西战役(或作"梅尔战役"(Battle of Winchelsea (或作"Les Es…
te: Battle of Winchelsea (or Les Espagnols sur Mer): The English naval fleet under King Edward III defeats a Castilian flee…
dz: 温切尔西战役(或作"梅尔战役"(Battle of Winchelsea (或作"Les Espagnols sur Mer"):由爱德华三世国王所领导的英国海军舰队击败了一支由40艘舰只组成的卡斯蒂利亚舰队.
de: Battle of Winchelsea (or Les Espagnols sur Mer): The English naval fleet under King Edward III defeats a Castilian fleet of 40 ships.

t: 蒙特卡蒂尼战役(Battle of Montecatini):由乌古乔内·德拉·法吉乌奥拉所指…
te: The army of the Republic of Pisa, commanded by Uguccione della Faggiuola, wins a decisive victory against the joint for…
dz: 蒙特卡蒂尼战役(Battle of Montecatini):由乌古乔内·德拉·法吉乌奥拉所指挥的比萨共和国军队,尽管寡不敌众,却对那不勒斯王国和佛罗伦萨共和国的联合部队取得了决定性的胜利.
de: Battle of Montecatini: The army of the Republic of Pisa, commanded by Uguccione della Faggiuola, wins a decisive victory against the joint forces of the Kingdom of Naples and the Republic of Florence despite being outnumbered.

t: 教宗乌尔班四世接任教宗亚历山大四世,成为第182任教宗.
te: Pope Urban IV succeeds Pope Alexander IV, becoming the 182nd pope.
dz: 教宗乌尔班四世接任教宗亚历山大四世,成为第182任教宗.
de: Pope Urban IV succeeds Pope Alexander IV, becoming the 182nd pope.

t: 法瑞库尔战役发生在第五次十字军东征期间.
te: The Battle of Fariskur occurs during the Fifth Crusade.
dz: 法瑞库尔战役发生在第五次十字军东征期间.
de: The Battle of Fariskur occurs during the Fifth Crusade.

t: 耶路撒冷国王阿马尔里克与拜占庭公主玛丽亚·科姆内(Maria Konnene)在提尔大教堂结婚.
te: King Amalric of Jerusalem marries Byzantine princess Maria Komnene in the cathedral of Tyre.
dz: 耶路撒冷国王阿马尔里克与拜占庭公主玛丽亚·科姆内(Maria Konnene)在提尔大教堂结婚.
de: King Amalric of Jerusalem marries Byzantine princess Maria Komnene in the cathedral of Tyre.
p: Cathedral of the Holy Cross, Tyre

t: 美因茨大教堂因起火而遭到大面积破坏,该建筑在落成当天被摧毁.
te: Mainz Cathedral suffers extensive damage from a fire, which destroys the building on the day of its inauguration.
dz: 美因茨大教堂因起火而遭到大面积破坏,该建筑在落成当天被摧毁.
de: Mainz Cathedral suffers extensive damage from a fire, which destroys the building on the day of its inauguration.

t: 梅利特城在被围困后向阿格拉比德军队投降,结束了拜占庭马耳他.
te: The city of Melite surrenders to an Aghlabid army following a siege, putting an end to Byzantine Malta.
dz: 梅利特城在被围困后向阿格拉比德军队投降,结束了拜占庭马耳他.
de: The city of Melite surrenders to an Aghlabid army following a siege, putting an end to Byzantine Malta.

t: 铜币在日本被首次铸造(日本传统日期:708年8月10日).
te: Copper coins are minted in Japan for the first time (Traditional Japanese date: August 10, 708).
dz: 铜币在日本被首次铸造(日本传统日期:708年8月10日).
de: Copper coins are minted in Japan for the first time (Traditional Japanese date: August 10, 708).
